tools.name: check_endpoint
tools.description: Get the trust verdict for one x402 endpoint: score (0-100), grade (A-F), and verdict (proceed, caution, avoid, free, or insufficient_data), plus uptime, delivery-test status, and payout-wallet incidents. Use it when you're deciding whether an endpoint is trustworthy at all, before you have a price q

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Decide whether a specific x402 payment should go through: returns allow true/false with reasons. Checks the endpoint's trust verdict, that the amount is within your cap and not above the monitored price, and that the payTo wallet matches the one we've observed (catches swapped or hijacked wallets).

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report whether a paid x402 call delivered a usable response, using the receipt from a Lumière PayCheck allow decision (the paid /v1/authorize API). Applies only to payments made with such a receipt, within 24 hours; reporting is optional. Not for checking endpoints (use check_endpoint or check_payme

tools.name: top_endpoints
tools.description: List the x402 endpoints that are currently safest to pay (verdict proceed or caution, no payout-wallet incidents), best first, with score, grade, verdict, and whether a real test payment was delivered. Use it to discover reliable endpoints or pick between providers. To evaluate one specific endpoint

tools.name: catalog_stats
tools.description: Get an overview of the whole monitored x402 catalog: how many endpoints are monitored, how many fall into each verdict (proceed, caution, avoid, free, insufficient_data), and when scores were last computed.
